flouds-branding.title: Flouds Performance Digital
flouds-branding.description: Visual identity for Flouds Performance Digital, a paid media and automation agency from Porto Alegre.

challenge.heading: Building a bold visual identity for a data-driven performance agency
challenge.body: Flouds is a paid media and automation agency focused on scaling business results through traffic, conversion strategy, and intelligent workflows. The goal was to build a strong, modern visual identity that reflects the agency's tech-driven approach, communicates trust and authority, and positions Flouds as a strategic growth partner for its clients.

result.heading: A cohesive identity connecting data, technology, and creativity
result.body: The final identity combines a bold and minimal aesthetic with a high-impact color palette centered on purple, black, and white, symbolizing performance, innovation, and precision. The geometric logotype brings a sense of movement and direction, representing the agency's mission: to connect data, technology, and creativity into scalable, measurable results.

yoursbank.title: Yours Bank
yoursbank.description: Website redesign for Yours Bank, a fintech focused on trust, conversion, and a more human digital experience.

challenge.heading: Translating Yours Bank's innovative proposition into a platform that builds trust and drives action
challenge.body: The previous site didn't reflect the fintech's value proposition or meet the expectations of users who needed to understand and trust the product. More than a visual redesign, the goal was to communicate security in a sector full of distrust, with a lightweight, conversion-focused structure.

result.heading: A more human, intuitive platform that simplifies communication and accelerates conversion
result.body: The result was a site that highlights Yours Bank's differentiators without noise. Content was simplified and the tone of voice reinforced approachability. The solution brought a reusable, scalable structure, making the experience more intuitive, building greater trust and increasing engagement at every conversion point.

flouds.title: Flouds Performance Digital
flouds.description: Website for Flouds Performance Digital, a conversion-focused site that works as a strategic acquisition channel for a paid media agency.

challenge.heading: Turning a data-driven brand into a high-performance digital presence
challenge.body: After building Flouds' visual identity, the next step was to transform their positioning into a digital presence that went beyond a simple showcase. The site needed to communicate authority, explain the value proposition clearly, and work as a strategic acquisition channel, converting visitors into qualified leads directly and effectively.

result.heading: A modern, strategic, conversion-focused website
result.body: The result was a solid and impactful site, with well-structured architecture, fluid navigation, and persuasive copy. The modern, objective design reflects the brand's technological DNA and guides users through a clear journey to conversion, making the site one of Flouds' main growth drivers.

msk.title: MSK Perfuradora de Metais
msk.description: Website for MSK Perfuradora de Metais, converting 26 years of industry expertise into a modern, lead-generating digital presence.

challenge.heading: Converting 26 years of expertise into a modern digital presence built to generate business
challenge.body: MSK is a reference in its sector, but their digital positioning didn't match that strength. The goal was to create a site that not only modernized their image, but functioned as a sales tool, making their vast product catalog easy to navigate and optimizing qualified lead capture.

result.heading: A UX-focused platform with a bold identity, built to turn visitors into clients
result.body: The result is a robust, intuitive platform that positions MSK as a market leader both online and offline. With a clear product catalog and multiple lead generation touchpoints, the new site became a central asset in the company's growth strategy, attracting new clients and reinforcing their authority.

sant.title: Sant Saúde
sant.description: Website for Sant Saúde, a performance-focused redesign that simplified content and improved navigation for a healthcare platform.

challenge.heading: Aligning a healthcare platform with its mission through usability and scalability
challenge.body: The previous site was overloaded. Excessive animations and a dense information architecture created a confusing and frustrating user experience. Slow loading times were a direct barrier for users seeking essential health information, compromising both performance and the effectiveness of the channel.

result.heading: A performance-focused design system that simplified content and navigation
result.body: By optimizing animations and organizing information logically, we delivered a visibly faster, scalable site that improves user engagement. The result is a platform that not only looks clean, but actually works, allowing users to find what they need quickly and effortlessly.

rmaq.title: RMAQ Assessoria
rmaq.description: Visual identity for RMAQ Assessoria, a business consultancy built on tradition, strategy, and professional clarity.

challenge.heading: Capturing the essence of a consultancy that blends tradition and strategic growth
challenge.body: RMAQ needed a visual identity that reflected its mission: helping businesses overcome challenges and optimize processes. The goal was to translate that authority into a cohesive brand, one that resonated with its audience while standing out in a competitive consulting market. Market research guided the direction, ensuring every decision was rooted in what the target audience actually values.

result.heading: A confident, professional identity built for consistency across every platform
result.body: The final identity pairs modern typography with a symbol representing growth and strategy, balancing authenticity with innovation. The color palette conveys trust and professionalism, while the typographic system ensures clarity at every touchpoint. All brand applications were designed for adaptability, maintaining visual consistency whether on digital or print platforms.
